name: Budapest University of Technology and Economics
summary: Budapest technical and economics university: twelve English-taught BSc and single-cycle degrees, entered through its own online tests.

ib.text: No IB points rule: the Diploma counts as your school-leaving certificate and an English-medium school certificate can replace an English test. Entry turns on BME's own online tests.

programmes.name: Civil Engineering
programmes.about: Four-year civil engineering degree in English (240 ECTS) with two specialisations, Structural Engineering and Infrastructure Engineering: bridges, buildings, roads, railways and water works.
programmes.selectionNote: Documents pre-screened (school results, motivation letter, activities), then an online Maths and Physics test in English. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Computer Science Engineering
programmes.about: Computer science, algorithms, programming, networks, AI and data security, with two specialisations from semester five: Software Engineering and Infocommunication (210 ECTS).
programmes.selectionNote: School certificate (70% minimum) pre-screened, then an online Maths and Physics test and a recorded oral test. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Electrical Engineering
programmes.about: Electrical and electronic engineering from power systems to microelectronics, control and programming, with specialisations in embedded and control systems, infocommunication or sustainable energy.
programmes.selectionNote: School certificate (70% minimum) pre-screened, then an online Maths and Physics test. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering
programmes.about: Mechanics, materials, fluid and thermal sciences and control, combined with laboratory and design work; a broad base for mechanical engineering practice (210 ECTS).
programmes.selectionNote: Documents pre-screened, then an online Maths and Physics test; no oral round. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Vehicle Engineering
programmes.about: Vehicle structures, systems, materials and maintenance, for the automotive industry's shift to new vehicle technologies (210 ECTS).
programmes.selectionNote: Documents pre-screened, then an online Maths and Physics test; no oral round. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Engineering Management
programmes.about: Engineering plus management: technology, IT, organisation and finance for planning and running technical and economic processes, taught project by project (210 ECTS).
programmes.selectionNote: Online test, then an online motivational interview on your interests and why you want the programme. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Professional Pilot
programmes.about: A BSc combined with a commercial pilot licence: flight theory and practical training, ending with multi-crew training in an Airbus A320 simulator environment (210 ECTS).
programmes.ib: Class 1 EASA medical certificate needed by the end of the first semester, at your own cost; apply with a general medical check.
programmes.selectionNote: Online Maths and Physics test and an oral round; apply with a general medical check. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Physics
programmes.about: Theoretical and experimental physics with mathematics and programming, with a Research Physicist or an Applied Physics specialisation, leading towards the BME Master's (180 ECTS).
programmes.selectionNote: Pre-screened on school results; online Maths and Physics test (advanced topics), then an online interview in English. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Physicist-Engineer
programmes.about: Engineering, physics, maths, computing and data science together: quantum and nano technology, photonics, materials, energy and nuclear technology (210 ECTS).
programmes.selectionNote: Pre-screened on school results; online Maths and Physics test (advanced topics), online interview; 70% admission result needed. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Mathematics
programmes.about: Pure and applied mathematics and mathematical modelling, with project work and a route to research or finance and IT jobs (180 ECTS).
programmes.selectionNote: Pre-screened on school results; online Maths test (advanced topics) and Physics test, then an oral round. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Chemical Engineering
programmes.about: Analytical, organic and materials chemistry with chemical engineering, maths, physics and economics; specialisation starts in semester five (210 ECTS).
programmes.selectionNote: Online test in Maths plus Chemistry or Physics; no oral round. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Architectural Engineering (single-cycle)
programmes.about: Five-year path straight to a master's in architectural engineering, balancing technical skills (maths and physics) with design; specialise from year four in real estate, sustainable architecture or urban design.
programmes.selectionNote: Online Maths and Physics test; maths and/or physics at school recommended; no oral round. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: EU citizens pay the EU column of BME's fee table, lower than the non-EU price for most degrees; Logistics and Transportation Engineering BSc are listed as not offered for 2026/27, so they are left out.
Every BSc applicant sits BME's own online e-admission test (Maths and Physics; Chemical Engineering: Maths plus Chemistry or Physics); practice tests are on the portal.
Applying costs a EUR 150 fee paid by transfer before you submit; BSc applicants must be 18 by enrolment.
